WITH lap_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id,
        driver_id,
        lap,
        position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_pos,
        position - LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as pos_diff
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap > 0
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, prev_pos, pos_diff
    FROM lap_changes
    WHERE prev_pos IS NOT NULL AND pos_diff != 0
),
pit_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap 
    FROM pit_stops
),
retirements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, TRY_CAST(lap AS BIGINT) as ret_lap
    FROM retirements
),
marked_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN pc.lap = 1 THEN 'first_lap'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pit_laps pl WHERE pl.race_id = pc.race_id AND pl.driver_id = pc.driver_id AND pl.lap = pc.lap) THEN 'pit_stop'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retirements r WHERE r.race_id = pc.race_id AND r.driver_id = pc.driver_id AND pc.lap >= r.ret_lap) THEN 'retirement'
            ELSE 'valid'
        END as exclusion_reason
    FROM position_changes pc
),
filtered_changes AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, pos_diff
    FROM marked_changes
    WHERE exclusion_reason = 'valid'
),
driver_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pos_diff < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overtake_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pos_diff > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overtaken_count
    FROM filtered_changes
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT 
    ds.driver_id,
    dext.full_name,
    ds.overtake_count,
    ds.overtaken_count,
    ds.overtaken_count - ds.overtake_count as diff
FROM driver_stats ds
JOIN drivers_ext dext ON ds.driver_id = dext.driver_id
WHERE ds.overtaken_count > ds.overtake_count
ORDER BY ds.overtaken_count DESC
